content: Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00337 An RTE_E_DET_ILLEGAL_VARIANT_CRITERION_VALUE (0x02) shall be reported by the Basic Software Scheduler when it determines that a value is assigned to a variant criterion which is not in the list of possible values for that criterion. This error shall be detected during the Basic Software Scheduler initialization phase.
